changelog: - **`all` on a Converter's connection is refused, and a loop that returns to its own Pool through a Gate or another Converter is now bounded like a direct one.** On a Gate or a Drain, `all` means the whole source Pool; on a connection into or out of a Converter the same word was read as one unit per activation, whatever the Pool held, with no word about it. A Converter's connection now accepts a number only: `all` there moves nothing, and the line under the run row names the connection and says which number keeps what it did (`1`). A Converter whose only input or only output is refused does not run; with another input it runs on that. Your file is not changed. Separately, a Converter that takes from a Pool and puts its product back into the same Pool was already allowed to fill the room its own take frees; when that take happened one step earlier in the chain, at a Gate or a Converter feeding it, the room was counted without it and the loop ran at a smaller fraction. The whole chain is now measured in the order it moves, so such a loop fills the Pool exactly to its capacity as a direct loop does. A saved Monte Carlo distribution computed before this change opens marked as from an earlier version of the engine until you run it again. None of the bundled examples changes.
